semantic_nodes.canonical_text: 9.3.1 Performing the constancy test
The monthly quality test is performed via the Quality IEC Constancy dialog box of the Additional Service window.
In the constancy test, the following factors are checked:
Phantom and phantom position check
Position of the lightmarker; Lightmarker
Position of the external lightmarker, if the hardware is available; External Lightm .
Position of the sagittal and coronal lightmarker; Sag./Cor. Lightm .
Automatic positioning of the tomographic plane using a preview image; Topogram Pos .
Tomographic slice thickness; Slice
Homogeneity; Homogeneity/Water
Pixel noise; Noise
Spatial resolution by calculation of the Modulation transfer function; MTF
Position of the patient table; Table Position
Measurement of the Computed Tomography Dose Index; CTDI-Air
Force / Force Velo | Instructions for Use Print No. C2-058-C.621.01.01.02
SOMATOM | syngo CT VB30 435
9 Quality assurance
If using the MPT, the standard table top must be positioned to perform the constancy test.
1 Call up Options > Service > Local Service, leave the password entries empty, and click OK .
The Home Menu dialog window is displayed.
2 Click Quality Assurance to display the Quality Assurance dialog box.
3 Select the IEC Constancy procedure.
The Quality IEC Constancy dialog box is displayed.

section.title: Starting the IEC constancy test
section.hierarchy_path: /Quality assurance/Constancy test/Performing the constancy test/Starting the IEC constancy test

semantic_nodes.canonical_text: Starting the IEC constancy test
A reference measurement follows the same sequence as a normal constancy test.
1 Confirm selection of the constancy test with Go .
You are prompted to enter the name of the tester and the material numbers of the phantoms.
2 Enter your name and the data required.
3 Prepare the measurement as described. ( Page 424 Quality assurance)
Table movement starts automatically.
4 Click Go when you have completed your preparations.
The "Quality Assurance Patient" is selected.
A Calibration is performed.
You are prompted to press Start .
5 Press the Start key on the control box.
You are prompted to select the required phantom.
6 Select the radio button of the phantom that is used for the current test.
System phantom with aluminum ball ( Page 425 Quality phantom)
System phantom with low contrast ( Page 425 Low contrast phantom) ( Page 426 Low contrast phantom (predecessor))
7 Confirm the settings with Go .
The phantom position is checked.
The system alerts you if the phantom is positioned incorrectly. Correct the position, if necessary.
The system then starts the first quality measurement. This is usually checking the Lightmarker position (z-positioning).
The several selected functions are started automatically.

section.title: Performing the slice thickness test
section.hierarchy_path: /Quality assurance/Constancy test/Performing the slice thickness test

semantic_nodes.canonical_text: 9.3.6 Performing the slice thickness test
The slice thickness is determined with the slice thickness phantom. For each slice thickness, a tomogram of the phantom is recorded and the reconstructed slice thickness is calculated from this.
◆ Press the Start key on the control box.
Scanning is started.
An image of the slice thickness phantom is displayed in the image area and the slice thickness is calculated. The procedure is repeated automatically for all defined modes.
Force / Force Velo | Instructions for Use Print No. C2-058-C.621.01.01.02
SOMATOM | syngo CT VB30 443
9 Quality assurance
After all slice thicknesses have been evaluated, the result of the test is displayed in the content area of the Quality IEC Constancy dialog box.
Use the vertical scroll bar to view all test results.
In the status and error message area the result of this test (in tolerance or out of tolerance) is displayed.

semantic_nodes.canonical_text: 9.3.8 Performing the pixel noise test
The pixel noise is determined from two tomograms of the water phantom in the same way as for the daily quality measurement. ( Page 431 Daily quality measurements)
◆ Press the Start key on the control box.
Scanning is started.
Two images of the water phantom are recorded with identical parameters. The difference between the first and the second measurement is shown.
Force / Force Velo | Instructions for Use Print No. C2-058-C.621.01.01.02
SOMATOM | syngo CT VB30 445
9 Quality assurance
The following evaluations are displayed:
ROI
Mean value of the CT value
Sigma value (pixel noise)
The measurement is repeated automatically for all defined modes. The results of the test are output in the content area of the Quality IEC Constancy dialog box.
Use the vertical scroll bar to view all test results.
In the status and error message area the result of this test (in tolerance or out of tolerance) is displayed.

semantic_nodes.canonical_text: 9.3.10 Performing the MTF test

The spatial resolution is characterized through the modulation transfer function (MTF). The MTF describes the sharpness of the reconstructed image. The test determines the contribution of spatial frequencies to the image. Images are measured with the wire phantom.
◆ Press the Start key on the control box.
Scanning is started.

The MTF is represented graphically as a function of the spatial frequency (object modulation, measured in line pairs per cm, LP/cm). In addition, several characteristic values, for example, 50% MTF, 10% MTF and 2% MTF are displayed.
10% MTF means that the frequency content has dropped to 10% of the value obtained at 0 Lp/cm.
The scan is displayed in the image area. The result image is calculated and stored in the local database.
The result image can be displayed in the Viewing task card after the constancy test has been completed. ( Page 449 Output of results)
The evaluation is done for several modes using different kernels. The results of the test are output in the content area of the Quality IEC Constancy dialog box.
Use the vertical scroll bar to view all test results.
In the status and error message area the result of this test (in tolerance or out of tolerance) is displayed.

section.title: Biannually testing the luminance homogeneity
section.hierarchy_path: /Quality assurance/Constancy test of the monitor/Performing the biannual visual tests of the monitor/Biannually testing the luminance homogeneity

semantic_nodes.canonical_text: Biannually testing the luminance homogeneity
1 In the Viewing task card, scroll to test image TG18-UN80.
2 Check the test image for interferences from the middle to the edges.

Typical LCDs contain asymmetric inequalities. As the human eye in general has a small sensibility for differences at low local frequencies, the inequalities are negligible, as long as the differences are not too distinct.
3 Document your test results and confirm them with date and initials.
The test result shows deviations.
◆ Contact Siemens Healthineers Service to set information.
Force / Force Velo | Instructions for Use Print No. C2-058-C.621.01.01.02
